versions.changelog:
- Added structured front matter with name, description, version, license, and metadata.
- No functional code changes; documentation update only.
- Documentation now specifies required environment variable and API homepage/documentation links in metadata.

- Improved documentation for setup, now clearly explains how to set the API key environment variable.
- Expanded and clarified trigger phrases, including multiple languages.
- Added concise example code snippets for both web and image searches.
- Updated parameter descriptions and example tasks for better clarity.
- Refined error handling section to use a table format.
- Added notes on checking credits and referenced full API documentation.

- Initial release of Serpshot Google Search API integration.
- Perform Google web and image searches using the Serpshot API.
- Support for up to 100 queries per request, with customizable location and language parameters.
- Requires user-provided Serpshot API key for all searches.
- Detailed usage instructions and example search tasks included.
